## Generic CRM task create v1.0
`testMode=true` bypasses the HTTP node. Configure the HTTPS profile and OAuth2 credential locally. The generic adapter expects `POST /tasks` with an idempotency key. Every provided field requires non-LLM provenance; unknown and empty values are rejected.
